dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you tell me about Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang is one of the Liyue Qixing. She oversees all of Liyue and its trade.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: You must forgive me for not being able to say more.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: But considering how well the two of you get along... You might simply be able to ask her if you desire answers.
